description:
We’re drag racing a Maserati GT2 Stradale against a Lamborghini Huracan STO over the 1/4-mile and 1/2-mile. They’ll also compete in a 100mph brake test. 

Explore new and used car deals with Carwow: https://bit.ly/Change-Your-Car-0108

It’s time for two track-focused supercars to go head-to-head! 

We’ve got Mat in the Maserati GT2 Stradale, and he’s lining up against a Lamborghini Huracan STO! The two are fairly evenly matched, but which will come out on top over the quarter-mile? Let’s take a closer look at the contenders… 

The Maserati is powered by a 3-litre twin-turbo V6, and this produces 640hp and 720Nm. This power is sent to the rear wheels only via a dual-clutch gearbox, and it weighs in at 1,475kg. 

Then we come to the Lambo. It’s equipped with a 5.2-litre naturally-aspirated V10, and this produces 640hp and 565Nm. It also has a dual-clutch gearbox sending power to the rear wheels only, but it’s slightly lighter than the Maserati, tipping the scales at 1,436kg.
